aey nabi ! jo cheez Allah ney tumharay liye halal ki hai , tum apni biwiyon ki khushnoodi hasil kernay kay liye ussay kiyon haram kertay ho-?   aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .
Allah ney tumhari qasmon say nikalney ka tareeqa muqarrar kerdiya hai .   aur Allah tumhara kaarsaz hai , aur wohi hai jiss ka ilm bhi kamil hai , hikmat bhi kamil .

aur yaad kero jab nabi ney apni kissi biwi say raz kay tor per aik baat kahi thi .   phir jab uss biwi ney woh baat kissi aur ko batla di ,   aur Allah ney yeh baat nabi per zahir kerdi to uss ney uss ka kuch hissa jatla diya , aur kuch hissay ko taal gaye .   phir jab unhon ney uss biwi ko woh baat jatlai to woh kehney lagen kay :  aap ko yeh baat kiss ney batai-?  nabi ney kaha kay :  mujhay uss ney batai jo baray ilm wala , boht ba-khabar hai .

. ( aey nabi ki biwiyo ! ) agar tum Allah kay huzoor tauba kerlo ( to yehi munasib hai ) kiyonkay tum dono kay dil maeel hogaye hain ,   aur agar tum nabi kay muqablay mein tum ney aik doosri ki madad ki , to ( yaad rakho kay ) unn ka sathi Allah hai , aur jibraeel hain , aur naik musalman hain , aur iss kay ilawa farishtay unn kay madadgaar hain .

agar woh tumhen talaq dey den to unn kay perwerdigar ko iss baat mein dair nahi lagay gi kay woh unn ko ( tumharay ) badlay mein aesi biwiyan ata farma dey jo tum sabb say behtar hon , musalman , emaan wali , itaat shiaar , tauba kernay wali , ibadat guzaar aur roza daar hon , chahye pehlay unn kay shohar rahey hon , ya woh kanwari hun .

aey emaan walo ! apney aap ko aur apney ghar walon ko uss aag say bachao jiss ka endhan insan aur pathar hon gay .   uss per sakht karray mizaj kay farishtay muqarrar hain jo Allah kay kissi hukum mein uss ki nafarmani nahi kertay , aur wohi kertay hain jiss ka unhen hukum diya jata hai .
aey kufr ikhtiyar kernay walo ! aaj maazraten paish matt kero . tumhen unhi aemal ka badla diya jaraha hai jo tum kiya kertay thay .

aey emaan walo ! Allah kay huzoor sachi tauba kero . kuch baeed nahi kay tumhara perwerdigar tumhari buraiyan tum say jhaarr dey , aur tumhen aesay baaghaat mein dakhil kerday jinn kay neechay nehren behti hain , uss din jab Allah nabi ko aur jo log unn kay sath emaan laye hain unn ko ruswa nahi keray ga . unn ka noor unn kay aagay aur unn ki dayen taraf dorr raha hoga .   woh keh rahey hon gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! humaray liye iss noor ko mukammal ker-dijiye ,   aur humari maghfirat farma dijiye . yaqeenan aap her cheez per poori qudrat rakhney walay hain .
aey nabi ! kafiron aur munafiqon say jihad kero ,   aur unn kay muqablay mein sakht hojao . aur unn ka thikana jahannum hai , aur woh boht bura thikana hai .

jinn logon  ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya hai , Allah unn kay liye nooh ki biwi aur loat ki biwi ko misal kay tor per paish kerta hai . yeh dono humaray do aesay bandon kay nikah mein then jo boht naik thay . phir unhon ney unn kay sath bey wafai ki ,   to woh dono Allah kay muqablay mein unn kay kuch bhi kaam nahi aaye , aur ( unn biwiyon say ) kaha gaya kay :  doosray janey walon kay sath tum bhi jahannum mein chali jao .

aur jinn logon  ney emaan ikhtiyar kiya hai , unn kay liye Allah , firon ki biwi ko misal kay tor per paish kerta hai   jab uss ney kaha tha kay :  meray perwerdigar ! meray liye apney paas jannat mein aik ghar bana dey , aur mujhay firon aur uss kay amal say nijat deydey , aur mujhay zalim logon  say bhi nijat ata farma .

neez imran ki beti maryam ko ( misal kay tor per paish kerta hai ) jinhon ney apni asmat ki hifazat ki , to hum ney uss mein apni rooh phoonk di ,   aur unhon ney apney perwerdigar ki baaton aur uss ki kitabon ki tasdeeq ki , aur woh itaat shiaar logon  mein shamil then .
